title: Protect marker header icon geometry in the maintained UI gate
outcome: The maintained gate catches a recurrence of the marker header padding cascade that collapses the previous, next and hide icons.
acceptance: A maintained UI regression check fails if marker header controls again inherit generic ghost-button horizontal padding that squeezes their icons, while preserving legitimate theme and control styling.
The check passes on the repaired input, and validation states whether it observes browser geometry or asserts source structure.
